response.original_title: Audio Obscura X Rijksmuseum present Underworld
response.overview: Legendary act Underworld live from one of the most iconic venues in the world. The Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam. An excellent performance including all standards like Rez, Cowgirl and of course Born Slippy. What started as a new wave act in the 80's turned into a groundbreaking Dance act in the 90's. Over the years Underworld has proven to be the best live act in Dance Music. During Amsterdam Dance Event they took over the bicycle passage beneath the Rijksmuseum. An event which could hold 2500 people but got 125.000 ticket requests. Unique footage since their last live recording is from the early 2000's.
